daily_available_at: max(component_available_at) after exact contiguous component check
execution_proxy: first same-symbol hourly source open strictly after the current UTC-day availability boundary and order_created_at; at most one attempt per UTC day
missing_hour: use first later available hour of that UTC day; otherwise leave pending
liquidity_lookback: 20 positive completed daily bars known at order creation
terminal: precommitted liquidation at latest hourly opening timestamp common to final frozen scanner observation set; instruction exists one UTC day earlier; exact source open required for each held symbol; terminal precedes same-boundary signal and evaluation stops
